From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Subscription continuity quick verification & churn signal actions

Team / BrightStart,

Quick heads-up on renewals: finance asked us to validate commit flags for contracts with renewal windows in the next 60 days so they can lock Q3 guidance. I uploaded a one-tab tracker (attached) with the current HubSpot stage and the proposed commit flag for each account. Please do the following by end of day Thursday (2027-06-16):

- Update HubSpot deal stage and "Commit" property for accounts you own (link below).
- For any deal you mark as No/At-Risk, add a 1-line reason code in the "Risk note" comment (procurement delay / pricing / technical concerns / exec budget).
- If churn looks likely, flag with the tag CHURN_SIGNAL and add the expected loss amount.

Highlights in the tracker (BrightStart row noted): we show them as "Review" today with a $215k ARR renewal. If your read differs, update the sheet and HubSpot.

Resources: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/987654321) and renewal pack in Drive. I attached the tracker and an agenda template for an exec touch if we need it.

Why this matters: finance needs a final scrub for Q3 planning on Friday; inaccurate commits will materially change the guidance.

Thanks — please confirm when you update your rows.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Renewal Success | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: BrightStart_renewal_sheet_Q3.xlsx (spreadsheet), BrightStart_exec_touch_agenda.pdf (pdf)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@brightstart.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subscription continuity quick verification & churn signal actions

Stephanie / team,

Confirmed — I updated the tracker and HubSpot for my book. Quick note on BrightStart: marking Commit = No and setting CHURN_SIGNAL. Procurement has pushed their internal review out 6+ weeks and pricing has come up as a blocker during the last two calls. I added the short risk note in the tracker: "Procurement delay + pricing sensitivity; evaluating lower-cost alternatives."

I also attached a 1-page summary (in the tracker tab) of outstanding items and suggested net-new savings options we can propose. Maria — happy to run through those live if you'd like.

Next steps I propose:
- Sales to send an updated cost/usage analysis and one-pager on trimmed footprint (Logan?)
- CS to propose a targeted exec-touch agenda (I drafted one in the attached agenda PDF)
- Revisit commit status after the exec touch or procurement update

Will follow up with a calendar invite if Maria wants the run-through this week.

Thanks,
Neha
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Hi Neha / Stephanie,

Thanks for the note and the transparency. Quick update from our side — procurement asked us to hold off on renewals while they complete a broader vendor consolidation review set to finish toward the end of July. That means our internal timeline for the Redwood renewal is slipping; we expect to know next steps after the July 28 procurement meeting.

On the substance: we are interested in a trimmed usage proposal (fewer seats & targeted feature opt-down) and any packaging that reduces spend without losing core functionality. Can you share a short one-pager and cost scenarios (50k / 100k / 150k reductions) before Friday 6/18? That will help us shape our ask to procurement.

Also, Maria from procurement is copied on this thread (procurement@brightstart.com) — she will coordinate the procurement-side questions.

Regards,

- Neha: keep BrightStart engaged; schedule a 30-min exec touch once Logan's one-pager is ready — invite Maria and their procurement lead.
- Finance: FYI — I've set the deal to CHURN_SIGNAL until we have the exec touch or a procurement decision.

Logan — I've copied the Drive link and HubSpot deal above. If you want me to draft the initial slide so we can co-run the call, I can carve out 30 minutes early Thu.
